document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Na-del-mann! Na-del-mann! The raw wind whispers in your 
ears. With the sound comes a compulsion to run toward its 
source,  to  somehow  touch  the  wintry  sky.  You  desperately 
want to reach—to merge—with whatever is up there. In the 
summons  is  an  offer:  existence  wilder  than  life,  death  that 
conquers death, change that transcends immortality.

The summons has a POW of 4D6+60. To resist it, make an opposed 
POW roll: if you succeed, go to 39; if you fail, or if you do not want 
to resist it, go to 215.
